authorization: User explicitly authorized completion of feasibility tests and a continue/redirect decision on 2026-10-24. One fixed diagnostic matrix, not an automatic third parameter search.

dataset_roles.massive: Already exposed half-DEV, SGD optimization/probability-link sensitivity, not an independent architecture.
dataset_roles.clinc: Fresh full official validation after model-free audit; no model or selector tuning; no DEV_MODEL; never pooled with MASSIVE.

resource_policy: Soft post-fit elapsed checks; shell timeout1200s for natural run. No retries/recipe search/GPU.

decision_policy.screen_scope: Descriptive practical feasibility, not statistical tests, novelty or thesis approval.
decision_policy.synthetic_evidence: Never overrides negative natural evidence to grant GO.
decision_policy.insufficient_signal: Practical NO_GO_CURRENT_HGC_METHOD means evidence does not support current investment, not universal failure.

cost_policy.pre_freeze_probe: all methods and seeds at B=100; must equal main frozen prefixes
cost_policy.post_freeze_target_measurement: raw normalized text -> frozen vectorizer.transform -> classifier.predict, 5 repetitions, median, warm-cache order fixed
cost_policy.full_baseline_scope: entire current-correct P, not full DEV_SELECTOR
cost_policy.suite_scope: all B=100 suites, including each of 20 stochastic seeds
cost_policy.reference_probabilities: shared historical f2 cache assumed; extra full-P score reconstruction measured separately, cache construction not free in general
cost_policy.history_setup: training and full-D f0-f2 inference reported separately, no invented amortization
cost_policy.target_benchmark_execution_count: 5*full_P plus 5*each primary-budget suite; research measurement costs, not deployment savings
cost_policy.risk_top: Independent risk group build and ranking; no TFIDF cost.

formal_test_policy: TEST/OOS model-free component audit only, never model input/prediction/evaluation

target_group.no_group_signal: zero; target depends only on difficulty

mechanisms.history_group: negation, except overlap uses additive negation/digit coefficients
limitations: Synthetic DGP, labels, confidence and histories are not trained model outputs.
Every scenario includes a genuinely informative margin comparator; no-group-signal control retains difficulty signal.
Same-seed scenarios/regimes are paired, not independent model families; selection seeds are aggregated within environment.
A positive synthetic result cannot establish natural-data superiority, net deployment savings, novelty or thesis acceptability.
Failure or reversal scenarios are retained; no parameter search or post-result mechanism changes.
Fixed feasibility closeout, not a formal evaluation or full core-method comparison.
SGD and LR remain linear classifiers on TFIDF; this changes optimization/probability link, not a neural architecture.
Independent CLINC data still has only two related SGD realizations per family; not population-level independent samples.
SGD multiclass probability is normalized one-vs-rest sigmoid, unlike prior LR softmax; compare methods within each same chain.
MASSIVE half-DEV was already exposed; do not pool with CLINC full validation.
Risk-LR, Behavior-Anchor, Legacy-adapt, Grad-PD, external slice finders, neural models and full ablations are not implemented.
Synthetic scenarios/difficulty/confidence are generated, not trained model outputs or natural efficacy evidence.
Cached-history cost uses fixed-order warm-cache medians and does not establish free historical setup or amortization.
No statistical superiority/noninferiority, universal failure, academic novelty or graduation approval follows from the feasibility screen.
